plan.description: Freeze and hash the synthetic measured attribute, specification, batch/time grid, linear model, poolability alpha and bounded extrapolation before reading outcomes.
Admit hash-bound synthetic measurements, units, unique increasing times, baseline, minimum counts and explicit censoring without substitution.
Compute per-batch fits, sequential slope/intercept F tests and pooled or individual one-sided mean-response bound crossings within the frozen horizon.
Reconcile n, degrees of freedom, selected model, capped crossing, negative results and any exploratory specification change.
Register ordinary domain artifacts and separate claims with one checkpoint for coordinator-owned independent review, leaving review unavailable.
